svg.title: Figure 3. Uncertainty narrows only as answers accumulate
svg.desc: Illustrative calculation, not study data. A funnel-shaped band shows the 95% confidence interval for a business observed in 40% of answers, narrowing as the number of answers grows from 5 to 200 on a log scale: 5 answers 12% to 77%; 10 answers 17% to 69%; 20 answers 22% to 61%; 50 answers 28% to 54%; 100 answers 31% to 50%; 200 answers 33% to 47%. A single answer records only named or not named.
svg.text: Uncertainty narrows only as answers accumulate
95% confidence interval for a business observed in 40% of answers, by number of answers
Answers collected under the same conditions (log scale)
A single answer cannot estimate a rate: it records only named or not named.
Calculation by Local AI Registry: 95% Wilson score intervals for an observed proportion of 0.40, assuming
independent answers under fixed conditions, computed at every whole number of answers from 5 to 200.
Illustrative; not drawn from any study’s data.
